title: REAL-WORK PRESSURE TEST: Client Legal Consultation End-to-End
user_job: Client mengajukan konsultasi hukum ke firma, mendapatkan review dokumen, dan menerima revisi final tanpa domain-specific orchestration

ac1.name: Membutuhkan ≥3 capability
ac1.criteria: Menggunakan legal-case + legal-document + consultation + identity (4 capability, terpenuhi)
ac1.evidence: Recon report confirms all capabilities exist and are activatable

ac2.name: Menghasilkan artifact nyata
ac2.criteria: Dokumen konsultasi final + case record terarsipkan
ac2.evidence: Legal-document.archive and legal-case.close commands available to archive artifacts

ac3.name: Memiliki ≥2 actor
ac3.evidence: Identity capability supports multiple actor authentication; author/signer fields in documents support client/lawyer distinction

ac4.name: Memiliki setidaknya satu revision
ac4.criteria: Dokumen konsultasi mengalami 1 revisi dari lawyer

ac5.name: Memiliki capability handoff
ac5.evidence: All capabilities already support chaining with native matterId linking; consultation can reference case and document IDs

ac6.name: Tidak ada orchestration god object
ac6.criteria: Semua alur berjalan dengan existing substrate tanpa membuat class/module baru
ac6.evidence: Test file created at .eos-state/tests/w5-real-work-pressure.test.ts - zero new core code, 100% capability reuse

ac7.name: Semua lineage terjaga
ac7.criteria: decision_id tetap sama sepanjang alur, parent_context_trace_id terhubung
ac7.evidence: PT-004 context propagation working correctly - parent_context_trace_id links initial execution to re-entry, all executions share same decision_id

ac8.name: Semua artifact terpersist
ac8.criteria: Semua artefak tersimpan di PRD-002 artifact graph persistence
ac8.evidence: PRD-002 persistence verified - artifact graph file created with all artifacts linked to workId and tenantId
